I couldn't open Settings. The simulator's input tools here can only take screenshots, open URLs, and launch or terminate apps. None of them can tap the screen, and I found no settings deep link in the app.

What I could confirm:
- The app is open on the "All chats" screen. There is no gear icon. Settings is reached through the **"A" avatar at the top left**, which opens the account/settings menu.
- The app registers the `element://` URL scheme, but the binary shows no settings route, so I did not guess at URLs.

To finish, tap the "A" avatar in the top-left corner of the simulator, then choose Settings from the menu. If you can give me a way to send taps (for example, `idb`, `axe`, or a UI test runner), I can do that step myself.
